report: Checking the Star-Spangled Banner National Historic Trail (US-4581) official centerline layer -- already wired in kpc-links data/trails-hand.json (chat 2's trail-build file), but Brandon found no trail line drawn yet on the site. Please confirm this layer actually returns features (test near Fort McHenry/Baltimore ~39.263,-76.580 and North Point MD ~39.21,-76.36) and list its field names. Also: please do one broad search (NPS IRMA Data Store irma.nps.gov, data.gov, NPS National Trails GIS pages) for an official ArcGIS/shapefile centerline for the Washington-Rochambeau Revolutionary Route National Historic Trail (US-4582, NPS unit WARO, designated 2021) -- I could not find one myself; it's missing from trails-hand.json entirely and may just not exist yet in NPS's GIS catalog (W3R is a newer trail).

results.item_about: This data depicts the official driving route and water route of the Star-Spangled Banner National Historic Trail.
